description: This file defines the UserPreferencesController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace. It manages user preferences by providing a method to retrieve preferences via a service. It includes dependency injection, error handling, and uses Slim framework components for HTTP request/response handling.

classes.name: UserPreferencesController
classes.description: Controller for handling user preferences related API requests, specifically to retrieve user preferences using a service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the UserPreferencesService dependency into the controller.

methods.name: getUserPreferences
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to fetch user preferences, returning JSON data on success or an error on failure.
